args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money was quantizing with ROUND_HALF_UP, but FIN-212 requires
banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), which the docstring already
stated. Fixes the nightly failure in tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The docstring already said banker's rounding, but the implementation didn't match.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` (commit 08d3cd5986) passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Please merge so this fix ships in today's release.

The fix is now on `main` (merged at `08d3cd5986`) and ready to ship in today's release.
